verdict.rationale: Rippling's payroll page claims you can 'Run payroll on your schedule' and process payroll as often as needed. That is a thin, glancing signal of pay-schedule flexibility. Nothing shows multiple concurrent pay schedules or specific frequencies assigned to different teams. missing for 10: documented support for multiple simultaneous pay schedules, explicit weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly frequency options, assigning schedules to different teams or groups, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set up multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) across different teams
